--[[

]]

local function RandName()
    local chars = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
    local name = ""
    for i = 1, math.random(10, 18) do
        name = name .. chars:sub(math.random(1, #chars), math.random(1, #chars))
    end
    return name
end

-- ==================== KEY SYSTEM (NO SAVE) ====================
local AdUrl = "https://link-center.net/7932970/uT1HQ0kwWbT5"

local function ValidateKey(key)
    if #key < 20 then return false end
    local sum = 0
    local mainPart = key:sub(1, -5)
    for i = 1, #mainPart do
        sum = sum + string.byte(mainPart, i) * (i % 7 + 1)
    end
    return (sum % 10000) == tonumber(key:sub(-4))
end

    gk.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

    act.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local key = kb.Text:gsub("%s", ""):upper()
        if key == "" then st.Text = "Enter a key first"; return end
        if ValidateKey(key) then
            st.Text = "Activated! Loading..."
            ActFrame.Visible = false
            task.wait(1)
            InitMainScript()

            st.Text = "Invalid key format"

end

-- ==================== MAIN SCRIPT ====================
function InitMainScript()
    if shared._VE_MAIN_LOADED then return end
    shared._VE_MAIN_LOADED = true
    
    task.wait(1 + math.random())
    
    local Profiles = {
        Default = {
            Aimbot = {Enabled=false,Silent=true,FOV=120,Smooth=4,AimPart="Head",SilentSpeed=0.4,SnapCooldown=0.05,LastSnapTime=0,ResolverEnabled=false,ResolverYaw=0,ResolverPitch=0,ResolverMode="Static",ResolverSpinSpeed=15,ResolverJitterRange=45},
            TriggerBot = {Enabled=false,Delay=0.04,UseKey=true,TriggerKey=Enum.KeyCode.E},
            ESP = {Enabled=false,Boxes=true,Names=true,Health=true,Distance=false,Snaplines=false,ColorEnemy=Color3.fromRGB(255,70,70),BoxStyle="Corner",NameSize=13,MaxDistance=500},
            Wallbang = {Enabled=false,MaxDistance=500},
            Hitbox = {Enabled=false,Size=3.2,Transparency=0.55,OnlyHead=true},
            Movement = {Bhop=false,BhopMinDelay=0.12,BhopMaxDelay=0.22,BhopNextJump=0,AutoStrafe=false,StrafeStrength=1.2},
            Visual = {FOVCircle=not IsMobile,FOVCircleColor=Color3.fromRGB(0,210,255),FOVCircleThickness=1.5,ThirdPerson=false,ThirdPersonDistance=8,NoRecoil=false,NoSpread=false}
        },
        HvH = {
            Aimbot = {Enabled=true,Silent=true,FOV=180,Smooth=1,AimPart="Head",SilentSpeed=0.8,SnapCooldown=0.02,LastSnapTime=0,ResolverEnabled=true,ResolverYaw=0,ResolverPitch=0,ResolverMode="Jitter",ResolverSpinSpeed=25,ResolverJitterRange=60},
            TriggerBot = {Enabled=true,Delay=0.01,UseKey=false,TriggerKey=Enum.KeyCode.E},
            ESP = {Enabled=true,Boxes=true,Names=true,Health=true,Distance=true,Snaplines=true,ColorEnemy=Color3.fromRGB(255,20,20),BoxStyle="Full",NameSize=14,MaxDistance=1000},
            Wallbang = {Enabled=true,MaxDistance=500},
            Hitbox = {Enabled=true,Size=4.5,Transparency=0.4,OnlyHead=false},
            Movement = {Bhop=true,BhopMinDelay=0.05,BhopMaxDelay=0.1,BhopNextJump=0,AutoStrafe=true,StrafeStrength=1.8},
            Visual = {FOVCircle=true,FOVCircleColor=Color3.fromRGB(255,0,80),FOVCircleThickness=2,ThirdPerson=true,ThirdPersonDistance=10,NoRecoil=true,NoSpread=true}
        },
        Legit = {
            Aimbot = {Enabled=true,Silent=false,FOV=80,Smooth=8,AimPart="Head",SilentSpeed=0.15,SnapCooldown=0.12,LastSnapTime=0,ResolverEnabled=false,ResolverYaw=0,ResolverPitch=0,ResolverMode="Static",ResolverSpinSpeed=10,ResolverJitterRange=20},
            TriggerBot = {Enabled=false,Delay=0.12,UseKey=true,TriggerKey=Enum.KeyCode.E},
            ESP = {Enabled=true,Boxes=true,Names=false,Health=true,Distance=false,Snaplines=false,ColorEnemy=Color3.fromRGB(200,200,200),BoxStyle="Corner",NameSize=13,MaxDistance=300},
            Wallbang = {Enabled=false,MaxDistance=300},
            Hitbox = {Enabled=false,Size=1.5,Transparency=0.7,OnlyHead=true},
            Movement = {Bhop=true,BhopMinDelay=0.18,BhopMaxDelay=0.28,BhopNextJump=0,AutoStrafe=false,StrafeStrength=1.0},
            Visual = {FOVCircle=true,FOVCircleColor=Color3.fromRGB(100,200,100),FOVCircleThickness=1,ThirdPerson=false,ThirdPersonDistance=6,NoRecoil=false,NoSpread=false}
        }
    }
    
    local function DeepCopy(tbl)
        local copy = {}
        for k, v in pairs(tbl) do
            if type(v) == "table" then copy[k] = DeepCopy(v) else copy[k] = v end
        end
        return copy
    end
    
    local ActiveProfile = "Default"
    local Settings = DeepCopy(Profiles.Default)
    
    local function LoadProfile(name)
        if not Profiles[name] then return end
        ActiveProfile = name
        Settings = DeepCopy(Profiles[name])
        Settings.Aimbot.LastSnapTime = 0
        Settings.Movement.BhopNextJump = 0
        if IsMobile and Settings.Aimbot.Enabled then HoldingAim = true
        elseif IsMobile then HoldingAim = false end
    end
    
    local HoldingAim = false
    local OriginalSizes = {}
    local ESPObjects = {}
    local GUIVisible = true
    local LastGuiToggle = 0
    
    local function GetEnemyFolder()
        local chars = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")
        if not chars then return nil end
        local t = chars:FindFirstChild("Terrorists")
        local ct = chars:FindFirstChild("Counter-Terrorists")
        if not t or not ct then return nil end
        return t:FindFirstChild(LocalPlayer.Name) and ct or t
    end
    
    local function IsAlive(c)
        if not c then return false end
        local h = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        return h and h.Health > 0
    end
    
    local function ApplyResolver(pos)
        if not Settings.Aimbot.ResolverEnabled then return pos end
        local mode = Settings.Aimbot.ResolverMode
        if mode == "Static" then
            return pos + Vector3.new(math.sin(math.rad(Settings.Aimbot.ResolverYaw))*2, math.tan(math.rad(Settings.Aimbot.ResolverPitch))*2, math.cos(math.rad(Settings.Aimbot.ResolverYaw))*2)
        elseif mode == "Jitter" then
            local j = math.rad(math.random(-Settings.Aimbot.ResolverJitterRange, Settings.Aimbot.ResolverJitterRange)/10)
            return pos + Vector3.new(math.sin(j)*2, 0, math.cos(j)*2)
        elseif mode == "Spin" then
            local a = tick() * Settings.Aimbot.ResolverSpinSpeed
            return pos + Vector3.new(math.sin(math.rad(a % 360))*3, 0, math.cos(math.rad(a % 360))*3)
        end
        return pos
    end
    
    local function GetTarget()
        local ef = GetEnemyFolder()
        if not ef then return nil end
        local best, bestDist = nil, Settings.Aimbot.FOV
        local center = Camera.ViewportSize/2
        for _, e in ipairs(ef:GetChildren()) do
            if IsAlive(e) then
                local p = e:FindFirstChild(Settings.Aimbot.AimPart) or e:FindFirstChild("Head")
                if p then
                    local sp, onScr = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(ApplyResolver(p.Position))
                    if onScr and sp.Z > 0 then
                        local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
                        if d < bestDist then bestDist = d; best = p end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return best
    end
    
    -- ESP Functions
    local function CreateESP(enemy)
        if ESPObjects[enemy] then return end
        ESPObjects[enemy] = {
            Box = Drawing.new("Square"), BoxTL = Drawing.new("Line"), BoxTR = Drawing.new("Line"),
            BoxBL = Drawing.new("Line"), BoxBR = Drawing.new("Line"), Name = Drawing.new("Text"),
            HealthBar = Drawing.new("Square"), HealthBG = Drawing.new("Square"),
            Snapline = Drawing.new("Line"), Distance = Drawing.new("Text")
        }
        local d = ESPObjects[enemy]
        d.Box.Thickness = 1.5; d.Box.Filled = false; d.Box.Visible = false
        for _, c in ipairs({d.BoxTL, d.BoxTR, d.BoxBL, d.BoxBR}) do
            c.Thickness = 2; c.Color = Settings.ESP.ColorEnemy; c.Visible = false
        end
        d.Name.Size = Settings.ESP.NameSize; d.Name.Center = true; d.Name.Outline = true; d.Name.Visible = false
        d.HealthBar.Filled = true; d.HealthBar.Visible = false
        d.HealthBG.Filled = true; d.HealthBG.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0); d.HealthBG.Visible = false
        d.Snapline.Thickness = 1; d.Snapline.Visible = false
        d.Distance.Size = 12; d.Distance.Center = true; d.Distance.Outline = true; d.Distance.Visible = false
    end
    
    local function RemoveESP(enemy)
        local data = ESPObjects[enemy]
        if not data then return end
        for _, v in pairs(data) do pcall(function() v:Remove() end) end
        ESPObjects[enemy] = nil
    end
    
    local function ClearAllESP()
        for enemy in pairs(ESPObjects) do RemoveESP(enemy) end
    end
    
    local function UpdateESP()
        if not Settings.ESP.Enabled then ClearAllESP(); return end
        local enemyFolder = GetEnemyFolder()
        if not enemyFolder then ClearAllESP(); return end
        local active = {}
        for _, enemy in ipairs(enemyFolder:GetChildren()) do
            active[enemy] = true
            if IsAlive(enemy) then
                CreateESP(enemy)
                local data = ESPObjects[enemy]
                local head = enemy:FindFirstChild("Head")
                local root = enemy:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hum = enemy:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if head and root and hum then
                    local top, onTop = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.1, 0))
                    local bottom = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0))
                    if onTop and top.Z > 0 then
                        local height = math.abs(top.Y - bottom.Y)
                        local width = height * 0.5
                        local x, y = top.X - width / 2, top.Y
                        local cornerLen = width * 0.25
                        if Settings.ESP.BoxStyle == "Full" then
                            data.Box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height); data.Box.Position = Vector2.new(x, y)
                            data.Box.Color = Settings.ESP.ColorEnemy; data.Box.Visible = Settings.ESP.Boxes
                            for _, c in ipairs({data.BoxTL, data.BoxTR, data.BoxBL, data.BoxBR}) do c.Visible = false end
                        else
                            data.Box.Visible = false
                            if Settings.ESP.Boxes then
                                data.BoxTL.From = Vector2.new(x, y); data.BoxTL.To = Vector2.new(x + cornerLen, y); data.BoxTL.Visible = true
                                data.BoxTR.From = Vector2.new(x + width, y); data.BoxTR.To = Vector2.new(x + width - cornerLen, y); data.BoxTR.Visible = true
                                data.BoxBL.From = Vector2.new(x, y + height); data.BoxBL.To = Vector2.new(x + cornerLen, y + height); data.BoxBL.Visible = true
                                data.BoxBR.From = Vector2.new(x + width, y + height); data.BoxBR.To = Vector2.new(x + width - cornerLen, y + height); data.BoxBR.Visible = true
                            else
                                for _, c in ipairs({data.BoxTL, data.BoxTR, data.BoxBL, data.BoxBR}) do c.Visible = false end
                            end
                        end
                        if Settings.ESP.Snaplines then
                            local sc = Camera.ViewportSize / 2
                            data.Snapline.From = Vector2.new(sc.X, Camera.ViewportSize.Y)
                            data.Snapline.To = Vector2.new(top.X, y + height)
                            data.Snapline.Color = Settings.ESP.ColorEnemy; data.Snapline.Visible = true
                        else data.Snapline.Visible = false end
                        data.Name.Text = enemy.Name; data.Name.Position = Vector2.new(top.X, y - 15)
                        data.Name.Color = Settings.ESP.ColorEnemy; data.Name.Size = Settings.ESP.NameSize; data.Name.Visible = Settings.ESP.Names
                        if Settings.ESP.Distance and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                            local dist = (root.Position - LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
                            data.Distance.Text = string.format("%.0fm", dist)
                            data.Distance.Position = Vector2.new(top.X, y + height + 4)
                            data.Distance.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1); data.Distance.Visible = true
                        else data.Distance.Visible = false end
                        if Settings.ESP.Health then
                            local pct = math.clamp(hum.Health / math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)
                            local barH = height * pct
                            data.HealthBG.Size = Vector2.new(3, height); data.HealthBG.Position = Vector2.new(x - 6, y); data.HealthBG.Visible = true
                            data.HealthBar.Size = Vector2.new(3, barH); data.HealthBar.Position = Vector2.new(x - 6, y + height - barH)
                            data.HealthBar.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255 * (1 - pct), 255 * pct, 50); data.HealthBar.Visible = true
                        else data.HealthBar.Visible = false; data.HealthBG.Visible = false end
                    else for _, v in pairs(data) do v.Visible = false end end
                end
            else RemoveESP(enemy) end
        end
        for enemy in pairs(ESPObjects) do if not active[enemy] then RemoveESP(enemy) end end
    end
    
    local function ShootThroughWalls()
        if not Settings.Wallbang.Enabled then return end
        if not IsAlive(LocalPlayer.Character) then return end
        local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
        local ef = GetEnemyFolder()
        if not ef then return end
        for _, enemy in ipairs(ef:GetChildren()) do
            if IsAlive(enemy) then
                local head = enemy:FindFirstChild("Head")
                if head then
                    local dist = (head.Position - origin).Magnitude
                    if dist < Settings.Wallbang.MaxDistance then
                        local dir = (head.Position - origin).Unit
                        local params = RaycastParams.new()
                        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character, Camera}
                        local hit = Workspace:Raycast(origin, dir * dist, params)
                        if hit and hit.Instance then
                            local model = hit.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                            if model == enemy then
                                local screenPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
                                pcall(function()
                                    local vim = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
                                    vim:SendMouseButtonEvent(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y, 0, true, game, 1)
                                    task.wait(0.03)
                                    vim:SendMouseButtonEvent(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y, 0, false, game, 1)
                                end)
                                return
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
        if gpe then return end
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            task.spawn(ShootThroughWalls)
        elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then
            HoldingAim = true
        end
    end)
    
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then
            HoldingAim = false
        end
    end)
    
    -- FOV Circle
    local FOVCircle = nil
    if not IsMobile then
        FOVCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")
        FOVCircle.NumSides = 48; FOVCircle.Filled = false; FOVCircle.Visible = false
    end
    
    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if Settings.Aimbot.Enabled and (HoldingAim or IsMobile) then
            local t = GetTarget()
            if t then
                local now = tick()
                if Settings.Aimbot.Silent or IsMobile then
                    if now - Settings.Aimbot.LastSnapTime >= Settings.Aimbot.SnapCooldown then
                        local cp = Camera.CFrame.Position
                        local tp = ApplyResolver(t.Position)
                        Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.new(cp, cp + (tp - cp).Unit), math.clamp(Settings.Aimbot.SilentSpeed, 0.15, 1.0))
                        Settings.Aimbot.LastSnapTime = now
                    end
                else
                    local sp = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(ApplyResolver(t.Position))
                    local c = Camera.ViewportSize/2
                    if mousemoverel then mousemoverel((sp.X - c.X)/Settings.Aimbot.Smooth, (sp.Y - c.Y)/Settings.Aimbot.Smooth) end
                end
            end
        end
        
        if IsAlive(LocalPlayer.Character) then
            local hum = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if Settings.Movement.Bhop and hum then
                local nt = tick()
                if nt >= Settings.Movement.BhopNextJump and hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
                    hum.Jump = true
                    Settings.Movement.BhopNextJump = nt + math.random()*(Settings.Movement.BhopMaxDelay - Settings.Movement.BhopMinDelay) + Settings.Movement.BhopMinDelay
                end
            end
            if Settings.Movement.AutoStrafe and hum and root and hum.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then
                local vel = root.Velocity
                local spd = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude
                if spd > 2 then
                    local dir = Camera.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(
                        UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) and -1 or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) and 1 or 0, 0,
                        UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) and -1 or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) and 1 or 0
                    )).Unit
                    root.Velocity = Vector3.new(dir.X * spd * Settings.Movement.StrafeStrength, vel.Y, dir.Z * spd * Settings.Movement.StrafeStrength)
                end
            end
        end
        
        if FOVCircle then
            FOVCircle.Position = Camera.ViewportSize/2
            FOVCircle.Radius = Settings.Aimbot.FOV
            FOVCircle.Visible = Settings.Visual.FOVCircle and Settings.Aimbot.Enabled
            FOVCircle.Color = Settings.Visual.FOVCircleColor
            FOVCircle.Thickness = Settings.Visual.FOVCircleThickness
        end
        
        UpdateESP()
    end)
    
    task.spawn(function()
        while task.wait(0.025) do
            if not Settings.TriggerBot.Enabled or not IsAlive(LocalPlayer.Character) then continue end
            if Settings.TriggerBot.UseKey and not UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Settings.TriggerBot.TriggerKey) then continue end

Aimbot – Smooth aim assistance with customizable FOV, aim key, target part, team check, and visibility check.

Triggerbot – Automatically fires when your crosshair is over an enemy.

Trigger Delay – Adjusts the delay before Triggerbot fires.

Hitbox Expander – Enlarges enemy hitboxes with adjustable size and transparency.

Box ESP – Displays 2D, 3D, or Corner Boxes around players.

Skeleton ESP – Draws player skeletons for improved visibility.

Tracer ESP – Draws tracers from your screen to enemy players.

Name ESP – Displays player names.

Health ESP – Shows player health bars.

Distance ESP – Displays the distance to each player.

Head Circle – Draws a circle around enemy heads.

Skin Changer – Applies custom weapon skins.
